limitations: No automatic quality pass or promotion. Incomplete coverage remains pending.
GPQA repeats each of 198 questions twice with different answer ordering; its bootstrap clusters by original question.

AIME uses30 sampled answers. NIAH uses40 generated prompts per cell; the three128K variants run asone owned120-request wave after exact-prompt cache warmups on both arms. Warmup outputs are not scores.
Actual large-query128K GPU symbols/shapes, occupancy and cache-hit counters require a separate audit. Requested concurrency120 alone does not prove coverage.
Sampling uses matched configured seeds and budgets, not bitwise replay of random variates across different batching.
